benchmark.description: SPDR S&P 500 ETF adjusted close (distributions reinvested); proxy for the S&P 500 total-return index, not the index itself
benchmark.label: SPY-Vergleich
benchmark.valuation_rule: portfolio: raw (split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted) close + dividend receivable from ex-date + cash on documented pay date; SPY: dividend-adjusted close (distributions reinvested). Same start session, same currency (USD). Never mix adjusted prices with separate dividend credits for the same asset.
benchmark.pay_date_source: Nasdaq dividend calendar (api.nasdaq.com/api/calendar/dividends?date=<ex-date>), amount cross-checked against yfinance; unknown pay date => no receivable and no cash, retried for 45 days

readiness_rule.resolution_policy: A CORPORATE_ACTION_RESOLVED entry needs a primary-source evidence URL and a date; it is never READY, never a buy candidate, and is reported separately. Timeouts, missing facts or ordinary index exits never create one.
readiness_rule.reason_v3: An evidenced CORPORATE_ACTION_RESOLVED case (final end of trading documented by Form 25 and the last cached session) satisfies the gate for that one filing key. It is never READY and never a buy candidate; the original expectation list is unchanged and 100 % of it must be READY or evidenced. Ordinary data gaps, timeouts and index exits never qualify.
